from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.promotions import apply_discount
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
print(apply_discount(Decimal('200.00'), 15))
print(apply_discount(10.00, 15))          # float amount
print(apply_discount('10.00', '15'))      # strings
print(apply_discount(Decimal('0.05'), 50)) # 0.025 -> half-up 0.03
print(apply_discount(Decimal('100.00'), 0))
print(apply_discount(Decimal('100.00'), 100))
for bad in [(True, 10), (Decimal('1'), True), (Decimal('1'), float('nan')), (Decimal('1'), float('inf')), ('abc', 10)]:
    try:
        apply_discount(*bad); print('NO ERROR', bad)
    except BillingError as e:
        print('BillingError', e.code, bad)
""}
